name: 上浮填充胶囊导航
title: 上浮填充胶囊导航
description: 胶囊导航条：悬停时一团颜色从条目底部涨起、文字向上滚进胶囊墨色，激活项的小圆点带速度拉伸地在条目间滑行；弹簧引擎 240Hz 子步积分、帧循环稳定后自睡，父容器放不下时折叠成汉堡按钮并以 clip-path 变形展开菜单面板，支持明暗主题、玻璃/实色表面、分体/一体布局与自定义高亮色。
cardDescription: 悬停填充从底部涨起、文字滚层翻转，激活圆点带拉伸滑行。

api.name: logo
api.description: Logo 标记；字符串按图片渲染，节点原样渲染

api.name: logoAlt
api.description: Logo 链接的无障碍标签

api.name: logoHref
api.description: Logo 链接指向的地址

api.name: items
api.type: { label: string; href?: string; icon?: ReactNode; ariaLabel?: string }[]
api.description: 导航条目；不带 href 渲染成按钮

api.name: activeHref
api.description: 受控选中项（按 href 匹配），传入后组件不再自选

api.name: defaultActiveIndex
api.description: 初始选中项（非受控模式）

api.name: onItemClick
api.description: 条目点击回调

api.name: linkComponent
api.description: 自定义链接组件（路由 Link），接收 href

api.name: theme
api.description: 表面与文字的明暗主题

api.name: layout
api.description: Logo 与导航条分体，还是包进同一颗胶囊

api.name: size
api.description: 高度、内距与字号三档

api.name: surface
api.description: 毛玻璃条、实色条，还是无底裸条

api.name: itemStyle
api.description: 裸链接，还是每项自带渐变瓷砖底

api.name: hoverEffect
api.description: 悬停效果：填充从底部升起、滑行胶囊，或无

api.description: 激活指示：滑行圆点、停在激活项的胶囊，或无

prompt:
Implement the "PillNav" component from zero: a pill navigation bar where hovering a link makes a colored fill rise up through it like liquid while the label rolls over into the pill's ink color, the active item keeps a floating dot that glides and stretches between items on springs, and on narrow parents the whole bar collapses into a single round burger that morphs open into a menu panel. Pure React + CSS, two files: PillNav.jsx (entry, spring engine, collapse logic) and PillNav.css (all styles). React >= 18; no runtime dependencies. No iframe, no external assets. ## Structure & rendering - Root is a `
` with `data-layout` (split | joined), `data-items` (itemStyle), `data-collapsed` / `data-open` / `data-panel` markers, and every theme/size token injected as inline CSS variables; `aria-label` from the ariaLabel prop. display inline-flex, gap from tokens, max-width 100%; the joined layout wraps everything in one padded 999px capsule (gap 2px, padding --pn-pad), split keeps separate floating surfaces with a 1px inset rim (`.pill-nav__rim`: inset shadow edge + top highlight) on each. - Size tokens (sm/md/lg): height --pn-h 36/44/52px, pad 3/4/5px, inner 30/36/42px, horizontal padding --pn-x 12/16/20px, font 13/14/15px, gap 6/8/10px, mark 18/22/26px; `--pn-roll = inner/2 + 0.7em` is the label roll distance. - Theme tokens: dark surface rgba(38,35,46,0.66), solid #26232e, edge rgba(255,255,255,0.08), text rgba(244,244,245,0.64), strong #f4f4f5, active pill a white→#ebebf0 vertical gradient with ink #121016, dot #f4f4f5, tile gradient #3a3644→#27242f for itemStyle pill; light surface rgba(240,240,243,0.8), solid #f0f0f3, edge rgba(24,24,27,0.07), text 60% #18181b, strong #18181b, active pill #2c2c31→#18181b gradient with white ink, dot #18181b, tile white→#f6f6f8. The glass surface adds backdrop blur(20px) saturate(1.6) and a deep two-part shadow; solid swaps in the opaque color; none removes surface, shadow, edge and rim. barColor/textColor/highlightColor/highlightTextColor override surface, text, pill fill/dot and pill ink (ink auto-picked by WCAG-ish luma: #121016 above luma 0.36, else #ffffff). - Split layout children: a round logo capsule (height --pn-h, or --pn-inner in joined) holding a link around the mark (logo string renders as an ``, node as-is; the mark spins 360° once per pointer enter, 0.9s, skipped on touch and reduced motion) plus the bar capsule (height --pn-h, padding --pn-pad) whose track holds, in paint order: the `
